steps: Go to https://www.swagbucks.com and sign up free with your email and password (must be 13+; under 18 needs a parent's approval).
Optionally install the Swagbucks app on Android for surveys and activities on the go.
Earn SB by completing surveys, using the Swagbucks search engine, watching videos, shopping through the portal, or playing games.
Watch your SB balance grow in your account dashboard (100 SB is worth about $1).
When ready, open the Rewards / Redeem section and choose a gift card (Amazon, Walmart, Target, etc.) or PayPal.
Confirm the redemption; complete identity verification if Swagbucks asks (photo ID or phone verification).
Receive your digital gift card or PayPal credit — rewards can take up to 10 business days, usually sooner.
timing: Redemption processing times vary; digital gift cards may take up to 10 business days (usually arrive sooner).
